recipe.visualDefinition: A central bronze-cast vulture sculpture formed into an ouroboros circle, set against a deep crimson, softly lit fabric background with textured, metallic-effect typography placed at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular sculpture centered on a square field
High-contrast metallic gold/bronze against deep red
Textured typography mirroring the scale pattern of the sculpture
Soft directional lighting creating subtle shadows on the fabric
coreInvariants: The vulture head biting its own tail

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The ouroboros sculpture is centrally positioned, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vulture's head at the top-center of the ring.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the body of the sculpture, punctuated by horizontal text blocks at the top and bottom margins.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample red space surrounding the central object, providing a dramatic, theatrical feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds with deep shadows; high value contrast on the metallic highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Internal horizontal hatching or scale-like texture within the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Modified serifs to appear sharp and claw-like
Internal fill replaced with a metallic, etched pattern
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both primary and secondary display text to maintain thematic consistency.
graphicDevices: Beveled edges on the central sculpture

candidateDirections.reason: Similar wide stance and sharp serifs
Classic Roman proportions with internal decorative lines

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of a bronze vulture sculpture shaped like an ouroboros (biting its tail) centered on a deep red velvet background with soft, moody lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered all-caps display text at the top and bottom using a wide serif font with a metallic, horizontally-hatched texture.

verificationChecks: Is the vulture head clearly visible at the top of the ring?
Does the red background have a fabric-like texture?
Is the typography textured rather than flat?

adjustableVariables: Level of detail in the vulture's scales
Thickness of the metallic text outline
mustRedesign: Original artist names and specific album titles

mustAchieve: Realistic metallic sheen on the sculpture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the ouroboros ring is a closed circle.
Check that the text texture matches the sculpture's metallic feel.
Verify the background lighting creates depth without washing out the red.
Confirm the vulture's eye is distinct and sculpted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Animal/Object] Ouroboros + [Deep Color] Velvet Background + [Textured Metallic] Serif Typography
